summary: A 16 m harbour tug: a lofted round-bilge hull with a raised flared bow, red antifouling below a black topside… joints door_l, door_r, radar, winch_drum, propeller, rudder; options hull, funnel; sockets seat_driver, eye_point, waterline, socket_tow, socket_bow, exhaust_0, ….
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.tugboat or place "prefab": "tugboat" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
